subject: Proposing a conversation on Parkinson's and GBA-related research
body:
Dear Silverstein Foundation team,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group for late-onset Parkinson disease.

A paper reports that the Silverstein Foundation for Parkinson's with GBA "began with the goal of aggressively seeking out new, cutting-edge therapeutic approaches to treating and preventing Parkinson's in GBA mutation carriers" [Ea3b320e].

Given this shared focus on Parkinson's, I believe there could be valuable common ground between our patient community and your foundation's work.

Would you be open to a brief introductory call, perhaps 20-30 minutes, to learn more about your current priorities and explore whether there are natural ways for our patient group to support or connect with your efforts?

Thank you for considering this, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader

Sources:
[Ea3b320e] https://silversteinfoundation.org/
